laws.rule: Tochigi Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (栃木県青少年健全育成条例), art. 48. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 5 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 栃木県青少年健全育成条例 (Tochigi), curfew for young people

laws.rule: Tochigi's 栃木県公衆に著しく迷惑をかける行為等の防止に関する条例 (Tochigi Ordinance on Preventing Acts That Seriously Trouble the Public), art. 3, bans indecent acts in public places and on public transport: touching a person in a way that shames or disgusts them, peeping at underwear or the body under clothing, and photographing underwear or the body under clothing (or trying to). Art. 9 sets up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to JPY 1,000,000 (about A$9,024); up to 2 years if habitual. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
laws.heading: 栃木県公衆に著しく迷惑をかける行為等の防止に関する条例 art. 3 (covert photography and indecent acts)
laws.penalty_signal: up to 1 year prison or JPY 1,000,000

laws.rule: Art. 8 of the same Tochigi ordinance bans touting (客引き) in public places for sexual services and for hostess-style bar hospitality. A breach of art. 8(1) carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707); art. 8(2), up to JPY 500,000 (about A$4,512). Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
